about: A writer drafts a note on what a password manager is, an evaluator asks for a revision, and the second draft is accepted. Both agents run on Gemini, free tier.
how: The evaluator answers with a verdict (accept or revise) and feedback. A revise sends the draft back to the writer, up to two rounds.
learns: An evaluator loop improves a draft: the feedback of one round is the input of the next.
watch: The feedback of the first round, and what the writer changed in the second draft.
